title: microcephala discoidea
intro: Microcephala discoidea, commonly known as the "Mistflower," is a flowering plant species native to Southeast Asia. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Microcephala discoidea are attributed to its antioxidant and anti-microbial properties, which may aid in wound healing and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
